entries.title: Careful work proves itself once, after its review
entries.body: A change you ask to ship carefully now has its code reviewed first, then shows it working once, and a reviewer reads that proof once before the pull request opens. Fixes during the review no longer run the whole proof again, and a later fix to wording or comments keeps the proof already shown, so careful work reaches its pull request sooner. What careful work proves is unchanged.
entries.noPicture: Nothing on screen changes; the crew works in a different order.
